steps._comment: v0.18 W5 -- THE COOLDOWN-BADGE LEG. The v0.16.2 close playtest flagged ZERO badge coverage: cooldowns shipped in GH#337 and the little number hotbar.gd draws in a cooling slot's top-right corner had never been photographed. This is the natural home for it -- the only class canonical whose PC fields a cooldown-holding kit at all (every other one either has no sword/bow line or is gated out of it by weapon_gated_kit), and the evolved-kit fight is exactly where a [Swordsman]'s Skills should be shown working. Kit order (granted_skills: swordsman's own L10 grants first, then inherited warrior grants, spear-family piercing_strikes stripped by the rusty sword): Attack(1)/Dash(2)/Quick Slash(3)/Flash Cut(4)/Power Strike(5)/Second Wind(6)/End Turn -- 6 numbered slots, 7 total, matching the ui_hotbar_rendered pin below. Power Strike is the ONLY cooldown holder in this kit (cooldown_rounds 2).

Close first: [Power Strike] is a damage_mult skill and routes through in_weapon_range, so with a sword it needs ADJACENCY -- opening its targeting from the spawn cell paints `targets: 0` and confirm reads as a cancel (that is what the first authoring of this leg measured). training_yard spawns the pc at (2,3) and training_dummy_a at (7,3); move_pool is 4 here (warrior's [Quick Movement] passive on top of the base 3), so four free steps land the pc at (6,3), adjacent, with all 4 AP still in hand for a 3 AP Power Strike.

The SIM-side twin of the badge: combat_hud's slot-info line and hotbar.gd's corner number read the same `cooldown_remaining`, so pinning the line makes the screenshot's number falsifiable rather than decorative.

payload_contains.text: [lb]Power Strike[rb] — 3 AP — ×2 damage — Recovering — ready in 2 rounds.

steps._comment: The badge is presentation, so it needs frames to land -- and it must be READ off the PNG, not inferred: hotbar.gd draws `cooldown_remaining` as a bare number in the slot's top-right corner, and nothing else on screen carries that fact.
